messages:
Priya Shah: quick sync — sprint 5 planning. post-launch notes: we have 4 P1 bugs, ~12 P2/P3, and several CS-driven enhancement requests. need a clear rule: do we prioritize all P1s + some enhancements, or keep sprint purely bug-focused? i want tradeoffs and a proposed scope by EOD.
Liam O'Connor: +1 on P1s first. can we commit to at most 2 medium-effort enhancs that unblock revenue or reduce ops? otherwise we wont clear the backlog. :thumbsup:
Jorge Morales: agree lean on bugs, but propose a simple triage score to pick enhancements: score = (customers_affected * severity_weight) / dev_days_est. pick top 2 with score > 4. e.g., #482 (embed retry) scores high.
Maya Chen: listing the P1s briefly —
• BUG-987: tokenization mismatch on long prompts (affects 3 customers, causes 500ms extra per request)
• BUG-1012: KV cache evictions under heavy batching -> incorrect continuations (prod incident yesterday)
• BUG-1033: auth header expiry not renewing in private deployments (customer-config)
• BUG-1050: streaming truncation on reconnects (intermittent)
we can validate fixes in staging and push canary in 48h for most.
Elena K: some of the P2s are duplicates of older tickets — I'll de-dupe and add notes. also FYI CS flagged enhancement REQ-221: route-level cost breakdown in console — high demand but ~5 dev days.
Priya Shah: thanks. here's a proposed launch criteria for sprint completion: all P1s closed + regression tests passing + canary <= 1% error increase for 24h. if REQ-221 is included, it must be scoped to the minimal MVP (route-level totals only).
Liam O'Connor: FYI REQ-221 would reduce support volume but is 5d. i'd prefer we do a smaller surface: add a "cost per model" column first (2d) and punt full routing totals.
Jorge Morales: agree with Liam. also propose we reserve an emergency slot (20% capacity) for any on-call hotfix if a P1 regresses after canary. avoids rework.
DevBot: incident created BUG-1012 (#5483) — assigned to @Jorge Morales, severity P1.
Maya Chen: concerning QA estimates — P1 fixes: BUG-987 (1d dev + 0.5d qa), BUG-1012 (2d dev + 1d qa), BUG-1033 (1d dev + 0.5d qa), BUG-1050 (1.5d dev + 0.5d qa). total ~8d dev, 2.5d qa.
Priya Shah: clear. proposed decision: sprint 5 scope = all P1s (mandatory), de-duped P2s only if <= 2 dev days each and >2 customers affected, include 1 low-effort enhancement (<=2 dev days) that reduces support load (cost column MVP). freeze all other enhancements. owners and delivery dates below. please ack or object by 3pm PT.
Elena K: ack. i'll handle de-dupe and owner assignments.
Liam O'Connor: ack. i'll take cost-column enhancement (PR #459).
Jorge Morales: ack, will start on BUG-1012 and coordinate with eng-oncall.
Maya Chen: ack, will prioritize QA on BUG-987 and BUG-1033.
Priya Shah: action items:
• Elena — de-dupe P2s and update tickets with customer impact (due EOD)
• Jorge — patch for BUG-1012 + test plan (due +2d)
• Liam — cost column MVP PR + story (due +3d)
• Maya — regression suite update and canary checklist (due +2d)
• Priya — publish sprint goals and freeze policy doc (due EOD)
Decision summary: sprint 5 = P1s required, one low-effort enhancement allowed (cost column), reserve 20% emergency capacity. rollback/acceptance gates: canary for 24h with <=1% error variance.
Priya Shah: if no objections by 3pm PT we ship this plan and I'll create the sprint ticket with priorities. :eyes:
